name: Purepure♥Peropero♥Princess ~Junshin Mahou Oujo no Dosukebe Kairaku Lesson~
original_name: ピュアピュア♥ぺろぺろ♥プリンセス　～純真魔法王女のドスケベ快楽レッスン～
source:
When the unlucky Toshio Kaname gets laid off from his job after working there for twenty long years, he wanders the night streets, finding ways to relieve that horrifying stress. To his surprise, a beautiful woman approaches him and suddenly asks Toshio to help her save her kingdom! It seems like a scam at first, but with nothing to lose, Toshio agrees to help the breathtaking stranger… But who knew that this would kickstart a fantasy adventure!

Help Princess Iris save her kingdom by rescuing the sealed god!

[From [url=https://www.kaguragames.com/product/pure-pure-pero-pero-princess/]Kagura Games[/url]]
